stem.text: Which arrangement of four molecules of water shows how water may cohere when moving up a xylem vessel?

stem.alt: Key: large circle labelled oxygen atom; small circle labelled hydrogen atom; dashed line labelled hydrogen bond.

A.alt: Four water molecules drawn as oxygen and hydrogen atoms, joined by dashed hydrogen bonds in a closed ring.

B.alt: Four water molecules drawn as oxygen and hydrogen atoms, joined by dashed hydrogen bonds in a straight chain.

C.alt: Four water molecules drawn as oxygen and hydrogen atoms, joined by dashed hydrogen bonds in a branched arrangement.

D.alt: Four water molecules drawn as oxygen and hydrogen atoms, joined by dashed hydrogen bonds in a bent chain.
